findings.en: included quota used; credits will continue
findings.current: cuota incluida agotada; continuará con créditos
findings.problem: The same English sentence ships on the relay surface as 'Asignación incluida agotada; continuará con créditos.' (relay.shell.usage.continue, committed, ledger-passed at the current en hash f53b23560b88), and this same panel says 'Asignación de pago ilimitada' for the paid allowance. One money object is named two ways, so a user comparing the surfaces can read them as different pools.
findings.suggestion: Asignación incluida agotada; continuará con créditos — or standardise on 'cuota' and move relay.shell in the same wave, then record the call in i18n/style-guides/es.md
findings.evidence: relay.shell es: usage.continue / paid / included / unlimited; tui.usage.paid.unlimited is byte-identical to relay.shell.usage.unlimited; the other three paid.* strings match relay exactly

findings.problem: {value} is a bare count of windows, so at one window the footer reads '1 agotadas' and '1 obsoletas'. English is invariant and cannot show this.
findings.evidence: usage_panel.py UsageStats.describe() passes str(count) and joins with ' · '; windows_count renders 'N ventanas'

findings.problem: 31 cells against en's 17 in a title row that truncates from the right; the mixed-state row is '2 con inicio de sesión caducado  · 2 obsoletas' = 46 cells against the 31-cell body at the supported 40x24 floor, where the English row's 28 cells fit. The second count is cut — the misreading the two-count split exists to prevent.
findings.suggestion: {value} sesión caducada (mixed row 32) or {value} caducadas (26) if the floor must stay whole
findings.evidence: usage_panel.py:1789-1800 (counts, join, truncate); PANEL_MIN_WIDTH 32, PANEL_PADDING_CELLS 4, SCROLLBAR_GUTTER_CELLS 1

findings.en: model-family caps still apply / Spend eligibility unknown
findings.current: siguen aplicándose los límites por familia de modelos / Elegibilidad para gasto desconocida
findings.problem: Both are single-line annotations truncated with an ellipsis (usage_panel.py:1039-1047). At the 31-cell floor body they clip where English does not (55 vs 31, 37 vs 27): the noun is lost in the first, and the 'unknown' qualifier — the one the sidecar says must not imply a side — is lost in the second.
findings.suggestion: los límites por familia siguen (30) and elegibilidad de gasto: desconocida (34), or record a width exception as cli.services_status did
findings.evidence: usage_panel.py:1039-1047; sidecar note 'Do not imply enabled or disabled'
